name: Email Hidden Formatter
description: A field formatter for email fields that renders a link instead of the address; clicking it reveals the email via an AJAX request.
project_description: The Email Hidden Formatter module adds an 'Email Hidden' field formatter (plugin id email_hidden) for core email fields. Instead of printing the address, the formatter renders a configurable text link; when a visitor clicks it, an AJAX request to a module route re-renders the email field in place with its default formatter, revealing the address on demand. The intent is to reduce exposure of email addresses to automated crawlers while keeping a smooth experience for real visitors on contact directories, staff listings and user profiles. The formatter respects the field's label-visibility setting (hidden, inline, above) from Manage display, and needs no extra libraries beyond Drupal core (it depends only on core field).
